subject: Request: vendor intake + NDA needed before executive demo — need to move timing
messages:
From: Asha Patel <asha.patel@medsync.io>
To: sergio_alvarez@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@medsync.io
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Executive demo — vendor intake steps before meeting

Hi Sergio,

Thanks for the calendar invite for next Tuesday. Quick heads-up from procurement: we can't proceed with an exec-level demo until our vendor intake is complete — specifically we need a completed vendor questionnaire and a signed NDA on file. Our vendor intake portal lists Redwood as a pending vendor (I attached the portal export for reference).

Can you share the completed questionnaire and a signed copy of your standard NDA? If you can get those to procurement by Friday EOD, we can keep the demo as scheduled; otherwise we need to move it until the intake is done.

Also, legal will need a point of contact from your side for the security questionnaire follow-up. Can you loop in the right person?

Thanks,
Asha
Vendor Operations, Medsync Health
asha.patel@medsync.io
Attachment: medsync_portal_export.csv (stub)
From: sergio_alvarez@redwood.com
To: Asha Patel <asha.patel@medsync.io>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 16 Jun 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Executive demo — vendor intake steps before meeting

Hi Asha — thanks for the heads-up and very reasonable ask.

Short answer: we can complete both items, but it will take a couple of days for legal to sign the NDA and for our security team to populate the questionnaire. I'll escalate internally to get the questionnaire filled and to get Legal to review the NDA today.

Practical next steps:
- Marissa (cc'd) from Legal will handle NDA review/signature.
- Ben (cc'd) — could you be the technical SME for the questionnaire follow-ups?
- Asha — if procurement can accept a signed NDA + the questionnaire draft by Monday 6/21 EOD, would you be OK keeping the demo at the original slot on 6/22? If not, we'll propose alternate times.

If we can't hit that Monday target, Sergio — my calendar shows I'm traveling 6/22–6/24 and won't be able to host a live exec session. We should plan for an alternate week or have Ben run the session if earlier is needed.

Attachment: redwood_vendor_questionnaire.pdf (stub)

—
Sergio Alvarez
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sergio_alvarez@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0197
From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: Asha Patel <asha.patel@medsync.io>, sergio_alvarez@redwood.com
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 17 Jun 2027 14:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Executive demo — vendor intake steps before meeting

Hi Asha,

Thanks for flagging. I've reviewed the NDA (see attached, redline in comments). The changes are minimal — standard mutual confidentiality language and a 12-month data retention clause we usually keep for hosted evaluation accounts. I can sign on behalf of Redwood once you confirm Medsync's signature block.

Ben — I'll need a quick tech read on sections 4–7 of the questionnaire related to isolation, key management, and audit logs. Could you take a pass today? Worst case, I'll collect what I can and sign conditionally pending Ben's notes.

Given Sergio's travel next week, and the procurement timeline, we should tentatively move the exec demo to the week of 6/28. Asha, can you indicate availability windows that week for your execs? If Medsync prefers to keep the 6/22 slot, Ben is available to run a product walkthrough but it won't be the full exec panel.

Marissa Cole
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
Attachment: nda_redwood_v1.3.pdf (stub)
From: Asha Patel <asha.patel@medsync.io>
To: sergio_alvarez@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@medsync.io, marissa_cole@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Executive demo — vendor intake steps before meeting

Thanks all for the quick turnaround. Procurement confirmed they can accept the NDA + questionnaire by Monday if the signed NDA is delivered today; I've asked our legal to countersign quickly. Given Sergio's travel and to make sure our execs can attend, let's reschedule for the week of 6/28.

Preferred windows: Tue 6/29 10–12 PT or Wed 6/30 14–16 PT. If those don't work, please propose alternatives. We'll mark the 6/22 slot as tentative and expect a cancellation notice.

We appreciate you moving quickly on the paperwork — once legal signs, I'll upload to the vendor portal and confirm.

Best,
Asha
Vendor Operations, Medsync Health
Attachment: procurement_confirmation.txt (stub)
